AAREYDRUGS.technical: Clearing prior 20-day high to notch fresh 52-week highs above rising 21-day EMA, 50-day SMA, and 200-day SMA. However, historical moves exhibit sharp churn without tight VCP structural symmetry.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: API and chemical trading player showing severe topline contraction (-56% YoY) with razor-thin operating margins (~2%) and subdued ROE (2.8%). Low interest coverage and erratic profitability fail CANSLIM investment-grade standards.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis fails on a drop below the 92.51 stop; breakdown through the 50-day moving average mandates immediate liquidation.

ACE.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout clearing 20-day resistance on 2.26× volume expansion to fresh highs. Meets all 8 Minervini Trend Template criteria with moving averages stacked constructively in sequence.
ACE.fundamental: Dominant mobile crane leader (~63% market share) delivering consistent 20%+ sales and net profit growth. Strong balance sheet with minimal debt, 22.8% ROE, and 31.6% ROCE provide solid CANSLIM credentials.
ACE.risk: Breakout fails below 1108.84 stop; violation of the 21-day EMA on heavy volume requires prompt risk reduction.

ANUHPHR.technical: Constructing a double-bottom pattern above the rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Volume expanded 1.16× on the turn, though upper-wick resistance reflects lingering overhead supply.
ANUHPHR.fundamental: Q1 FY27 net profit rebounded sharply (+38% YoY), but topline growth remains sluggish at +4%. ROCE sits around 15% with zero debt, yet multi-quarter sales momentum is not fully established.
ANUHPHR.risk: Setup invalidates if price slips below the 88.33 stop; close below the 50-day SMA voids the double-bottom base.

AONELIQUID.technical: Displays nominal staircase ticks typical of overnight cash repo instruments. Lacks genuine equity volatility, consolidation structure, and institutional accumulation characteristics required for SEPA or Darvas breakout trading.
AONELIQUID.fundamental: Angel One Nifty 1D Rate Liquid ETF is a debt-based money-market fund tracking overnight collateralized borrowing rates. Equities-based CANSLIM growth, EPS, sales margins, and ROE metrics are completely inapplicable.
AONELIQUID.risk: Not an equity candidate. Instrument stop at 1077.66 reflects cash NAV management, not tradable equity momentum.

ARTEMISMED.technical: Formed a textbook double bottom clearing neckline resistance with a strong bullish engulfing bar. Price is tracking above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with steady relative strength.
ARTEMISMED.fundamental: Tertiary healthcare operator demonstrating pristine CANSLIM earnings acceleration from 26% to 47% alongside 15% revenue expansion. Net margins widened to 11% with manageable debt and solid backing from Apollo Tyres Group.
ARTEMISMED.risk: Pattern breaks down on a close below 332.85; failure to hold the 50-day average requires immediate discipline.

BBTCL.technical: Double-bottom neckline retest holding above rising 21-day EMA, 50-day SMA, and 200-day SMA. However, recent candles reflect slight doji indecision near recent swing highs that requires volume absorption.
BBTCL.fundamental: Automated packaging manufacturer showing explosive earnings growth off base operational leverage. High promoter ownership (73.8%), zero promoter pledge, and healthy 18.2% ROE satisfy core CANSLIM institutional criteria.
BBTCL.risk: Base structure fails below 242.93 stop; exit if price undercuts the ascending 50-day SMA on heavy volume.
